verdict.rationale: Founder Law documents a managed EB-1A, EB-1B and EB-2 NIW package that runs 'from strategy to approval'. It also refers to 'mapping a multi-year path to an EB-1A' and offers an Immigration Roadmap in its strategy session, alongside separate O-1A work-visa packages. However, no evidence explicitly documents sequencing the O-1 into a green-card continuation strategy. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an O-1-to-EB-1A/NIW transition strategy, details on how evidence or timing carries over from the work visa to the green card, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a founder, the provider documents the green-card continuation — EB-1A or EB-2 NIW strategy after the work visa — so the O-1 is a path, not a dead end

citations.quote: EB-1A, EB-1B, and EB-2 NIW. Fully managed from strategy to approval.
a senior engineer mapping a multi-year path to an EB-1A
Covers O-1A, H-1B, L-1, E-3, and TN petitions and transfers with absolute cost certainty.
